$comment: Machine-readable summary of the Charness License for people and AI agents deciding whether a licence is needed and what it costs. LICENSE is the binding text; the repository's tests keep the two in agreement.

organizationLicence.rule: Find the band of R and the band of H separately and pay the higher price.

aiTraining.fee: the group's band price (organizationLicence), yearly, for every year the group uses, sells or offers a model trained on Charness code or commits; $0 only in the Free band; an individual counts as a group of its own
aiTraining.proof: the paid invoice and its receipt

oem.rule: The supplier pays the greater of its organization licence fee and the OEM amount, never their sum.

steps: Check Part 1. If your group is free, you need nothing.
Work out the price: your band (section 3.1) from the latest month-end figures, and any discount (section 3.6).

Send an order to charnesshub@gmail.com with: the organization's legal name and country, the group it covers, its R and H bands, the term (1, 2 or 3 years), the discounts wanted, and the e-mail for the invoice. For the AI training licence (section 3.3), say so.
Pay the invoice you get back.
Keep the invoice and the receipt: together they are your licence and its proof. There is no key and nothing to install.
